title: Diptych with Football and Targets 2
description: Two framed collages displayed side by side against a tan mat. Left panel features a dense layering of targets, warplanes, vinyl records, and an american football; right panel presents a sparse geometric composition with large color blocks, a bullseye, and a football at lower center.
composition: two framed works side by side
